news.title: 🔥 Video Effects & Visual Enhancements!
news.description: Fire and smoke video effects added for epic card plays! Fire cards now burst with real flames, critical hits explode, and defeated cards puff with smoke. Enhanced turn timer visibility - now always shows during your turn!

news.title: Profile & Avatar Fixes
news.description: Fixed avatar saving - your chosen avatar now persists across sessions. Added NEUTRAL element card image (Shifter). Ember the Firestarter now has custom background and card back!

news.title: Enhanced Player Profiles!
news.description: Major profile update with 20 new avatar options, element mastery tracking, 12 achievements, enhanced match history with timestamps, and improved stats visualization!

news.title: Performance Optimization
news.description: Code splitting implementation reduces initial load by 14%. Faster Time to Interactive with 23 lazy-loaded chunks. Better caching for improved performance.

news.title: Story Mode & Tutorial
news.description: New story mode with 10 chapters, comprehensive tutorial system, and strategic gameplay guides. Perfect for new players!

events.title: Coming Soon: Weekend Tournament
events.description: Battle for glory! Top players win exclusive rewards including legendary cards, special badges, and bonus coins.
